events.name: Awake
events.description: Awake is called when an enabled script instance is being loaded.

events.name: Start
events.description: Start is called on the frame when a script is enabled just before any of the Update methods are called the first time.

events.name: Update
events.description: Update is called every frame, if the MonoBehaviour is enabled.

events.name: FixedUpdate
events.description: Frame-rate independent MonoBehaviour.FixedUpdate message for physics calculations.

events.name: LateUpdate
events.description: LateUpdate is called every frame, if the Behaviour is enabled, after all Update functions have been called.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: This function is called when the object becomes enabled and active.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: This function is called when the behaviour becomes disabled or inactive.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: Destroying the attached Behaviour will result in the game or Scene receiving OnDestroy.

events.name: OnTriggerEnter
events.description: When a GameObject collides with another GameObject, Unity calls OnTriggerEnter.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: The other Collider involved in this collision.

events.name: OnTriggerStay
events.description: OnTriggerStay is called almost all the frames for every Collider other that is touching the trigger.

events.name: OnTriggerExit
events.description: OnTriggerExit is called when the Collider other has stopped touching the trigger.

events.name: OnTriggerEnter2D
events.description: Sent when another object enters a trigger collider attached to this object (2D physics only).

events.name: OnCollisionEnter
events.description: OnCollisionEnter is called when this collider/rigidbody has begun touching another rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionStay
events.description: OnCollisionStay is called once per frame for every collider/rigidbody that is touching rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionExit
events.description: OnCollisionExit is called when this collider/rigidbody has stopped touching another rigidbody/collider.

events.name: OnCollisionEnter2D
events.description: Sent when an incoming collider makes contact with this object's collider (2D physics only).

events.name: OnGUI
events.description: OnGUI is called for rendering and handling GUI events.

events.name: OnDrawGizmos
events.description: Implement OnDrawGizmos if you want to draw gizmos that are also pickable and always drawn.

events.name: OnDrawGizmosSelected
events.description: Implement OnDrawGizmosSelected to draw a gizmo if the object is selected.

events.name: OnValidate
events.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Reset to default values.

events.name: OnApplicationPause
events.description: Sent to all GameObjects when the application pauses.

events.name: OnApplicationQuit
events.description: Sent to all game objects before the application quits.

events.name: OnAnimatorIK
events.description: Callback for setting up animation IK (inverse kinematics).

events.name: OnAnimatorMove
events.description: Callback for processing animation movements for modifying root motion.

events.name: OnBecameVisible
events.description: OnBecameVisible is called when the renderer became visible by any camera.

events.name: OnBecameInvisible
events.description: OnBecameInvisible is called when the renderer is no longer visible by any camera.

events.name: OnRenderObject
events.description: OnRenderObject is called after camera has rendered the Scene.

events.name: OnMouseDown
events.description: OnMouseDown is called when the user has pressed the mouse button while over the Collider.

events.name: Awake
events.description: This function is called when the ScriptableObject script is started.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: This function is called when the object is loaded.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: This function is called when the scriptable object goes out of scope.

events.name: OnDestroy
events.description: This function is called when the scriptable object will be destroyed.

events.name: OnValidate
events.description: Editor-only function that Unity calls when the script is loaded or a value changes in the Inspector.

events.name: Reset
events.description: Reset to default values.

events.name: OnStateEnter
events.description: Called on the first Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

events.name: OnStateUpdate
events.description: Called on each Update frame between OnStateEnter and OnStateExit callbacks.

events.name: OnStateExit
events.description: Called on the last Update frame when a state machine evaluates this state.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: Called when the Editor object becomes active.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: Called when the Editor object becomes inactive.

events.name: OnInspectorGUI
events.description: Implement this function to make a custom inspector.

events.name: OnSceneGUI
events.description: Enables the Editor to handle an event in the Scene view.

events.name: CreateInspectorGUI
events.description: Implement this method to make a custom UIElements inspector.

events.name: OnEnable
events.description: Called when the window is loaded.

events.name: OnDisable
events.description: Called when the window is closed or disabled.

events.name: OnGUI
events.description: Implement your own Editor GUI here.

events.name: CreateGUI
events.description: CreateGUI is called when the EditorWindow's root VisualElement is ready to be populated.

events.name: Update
events.description: Called 100 times per second on all visible windows.

events.name: OnPreprocessTexture
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification before a texture imports.

events.name: OnPostprocessTexture
events.description: Add this function in a subclass to get a notification when a texture asset has finished importing.

events.name: OnPostprocessAllAssets
events.description: This is called after importing of any number of assets is complete.

events.name: OnNetworkSpawn
events.description: Gets called when the NetworkObject is spawned on the network.

events.name: OnNetworkDespawn
events.description: Gets called when the NetworkObject is despawned.
